device.description: 12-bit 1 MSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with internal temperature sensor, internal reference and SPI interface
device.note: ads8028.pdf (SBAS549B) p.2 absolute maximum (digital pins), p.4 electrical characteristics (DVDD 1.65-5.25 V), p.6 timing (Figure 1, tDV_CSDO 17 ns, tD_CKDO 32 ns max, tDZ_CSDO 26 ns, tCONV 100 us for the temperature sensor), p.7 pin assignments, p.16 transfer characteristic (straight binary), p.17 serial interface (Figure 33), p.18 Control Register (Table 2), p.19 output data format (Table 3: ADD[3:0] + DB[11:0]), p.20 temperature sensor channel and TM_BUSY, p.20-22 modes of operation, p.23-24 power-down and RESET (PD/RST)

notModeled: analog inputs, reference selection (EXT_REF stored only); the result is always the 0 V code 000h; the temperature sensor channel (8/9) also returns 000h (0 degC in twos complement)

channel sequencing: with several AIN bits set the device converts the selected channels in ascending order in successive frames, REPEAT re-runs the sequence, and DOUT returns all 1s when the sequence is complete or no channel is selected; the model converts the last single channel written (a multi-channel write keeps the previous channel code)
pipelining: the channel written in frame N is converted in frame N+1 and read in N+2; the model converts at each CS fall on the channel already selected, so ADD[3:0] reports it one frame early
the 16-SCLK rule: a CS rise before 16 SCLKs aborts the conversion and leaves the Control Register unchanged (the commands only complete at 16 bits, so the register part is honored)
TM_BUSY blocking: while a temperature conversion runs (100 us) further frames are ignored and DOUT returns all 1s; STANDBY = 1 aborts it
STANDBY mode (stored only) and the power-up times tPU_STANDBY / tPOWER_UP
PD/RST: a low pulse < 60 ns resets the Control Register, > 90 ns enters power-down (also resetting the register); both are modeled as reset while low
pin table lists TM_BUSY as 'Digital input'; it is the busy output (p.7, p.20)
SPI mode: SCLK idles high (Figure 1), DIN latched and DOUT launched on SCLK falling edges with the first bit (ADD3) out at CS fall: mode 2
